name: CCM - Lee Lean
description_html:
DO NOT OVERWRITE OLD VERSIONS OF CHARACTERS WITH NEW UPDATES, YOUR PROGRESSION WILL!! BE LOST

Lee Lean

A Character to be used.
in extension with CCM ( Combined Configurations Mod )
CCM, serves as the template for all Characters to be based on.
giving them skills and attributs within those parameters.
made possible by SVM - and the CCM Preset
they are ment to be used in COOP.
with SPT-Realism and Path To Tarkov
by Fontaine and Trap.

however, it is not a requirement.

For further information about CCM. check
CCM

they can also be used and enjoyed, for vanilla SPT.
with whatever individual MOD combination you use.

The notorious Lee Lean is a master in the art of corners and angles. With Lamborghini peeks and tactical awareness, he dominates CQB areas with deadly precision.
buildings, walls, side alleys, doorways and corner of windows.
using swift aim and side leaning. From corner to corner, to the left and to the right, he leans and swiftly takes.
out any SCAV or PMC dumb enough to challenge him in his natural habitat, making maximum use of hard cover. he leans, then he swings**

Skills:

  • Endurance
  • Assault Rifle Training
  • Aim Drills
  • Higher HP in arms and legs

Weaknesses:

  • Open areas, long range

  • Direct fire to torso and stomach

  • Little to no core strength to carry loot or handle bigger weapons

    Installation. 1 and 2.**

    installation 1, for only Lee. with no backup system. or extension for future CCM Characters to be stored

    1. Download zip file.
    2. Extract user folder inside Folder “installation 1” into root SPT
    3. Done.

    installation 2, + CCM extension for Future CCM characters to automaticly be stored in
    same concept.     1. Download zip file
    2 extract user inside folder “instalaltion 2” into root SPT
    3. navigate to user/ profiles - CCM Characters folder ready.
    4. Backup all your existing profile.json files.
    5. go to CCM, and copy lee ( or whatever CCM Character you wish to play ) into profiles folder.
    6. Done

    Thank you:
    Fontaine.
    Trap.
    GhostFenixx
